verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at developer.box.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured Box Dev Docs index. Box also serves agent-readable markdown versions of its docs (the _llms/en/*.md and agent-configurator.md pages), so an agent can be pointed directly at them. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Sign up for a Box free developer account, generate the developer token and make your first API call.
Configure Box AI API agents with a visual configurator.
